_doc: Pinrose gallery room geometry, read from media/gallery.jpeg + media/gallery2.jpeg.
Units: centimetres. Plan frame: origin = where the west wall line meets the north wall line of the west (68 m2) section; +x = east (right on the plan), +y = south (down on the plan).

Each wall is a polyline along its MOUNTING FACE (the interior face, which is what the plan dimensions measure). 'side' says which side of the direction of travel that face looks into: 'right' or 'left' (in plan, y down). The wall body extends to the other side by 'thickness'.
kind: target = mounting wall of the Great Gallery (blue outline); optional = corridor wall, mountable only when the 'corridor walls' toggle is on; excluded = drawn for context, never mountable.
source: 'dimension' = length taken from a number written on the plan; 'plan-estimate' = position read off the drawing (no number on the plan) - CONFIRM ON SITE.
Distance-along-wall in the CSV export is measured from the FIRST point of the wall's polyline.
kind 'glass' = glazed facade: rendered as glass, never mountable.

_doc: Existing ceiling grid (4x4 cm metal), per Eily's sketch on the plan view (2026-11-23): in each space a 3x3 grid about 80 cm from the walls, with cut (diagonal) corners.
Per zone: rectangle x0..x1, y0..y1 (plan cm) split into nx x ny cells; 'keep' = half-planes [a, b, c] meaning a*x + b*y >= c that cut the corners. APPROXIMATE - edit here.

inner.note: NW cut parallel to the NW diagonal wall, 80 cm off it (x + y >= 260 + 80*sqrt2); SE cut x + y <= 1340 read off the sketch

outer.note: SW cut parallel to the '240' diagonal wall, 80 cm off it (x - y >= 290 + 80*sqrt2)

partitions._doc: Rotating partitions on the inner/outer divider (Eily): 1 m wide, pivot on the centre axis, full height minus 3 cm top and bottom. Count 5 (as in the model) evenly along the divider - confirm.

wallProfiles._doc: White 17x17 mm square profile (electric channel) on the walls; default = continuation of the ceiling-grid lines down each wall + one horizontal run under the ceiling.
